name: Yılanlı Sütun
source: Built with Grokisual's LandmarkKit (1786 Istanbul project, istanbul_1786_3d.html, builders + spec copied unchanged; today state: fill 0); spec sources: A. M. Mansel, "İstanbul'daki Burmalı Sütun", Belleten (TTK): 5.35 m bronze, Ø 0.54 m below / 0.41 m above (Gauer: 0.63 m), 29 coils; all three heads broke off on 21 Oct 1700 (Silâhdar, Nusretnâme); half-buried by the rising Atmeydanı level; first excavation Nov 1855 (Newton); today a 6.5 m walled pit 3 m deep | İBB Tarihi Eserler, "Serpent Column" (heads lost after the 16th c.; lower part below ground until the mid-19th-c. excavation) | OpenStreetMap node 415157636 (position)
